police_front_desk.speaker: Desk Sergeant
police_front_desk.text: City Police. If this is about the suspicious pigeon, we already have a description.

police_front_desk.speaker: You
police_front_desk.text: Just checking that this number works.

spy_shop.speaker: Shopkeeper
spy_shop.text: Discreet Supplies. This conversation is not being recorded by us.

spy_shop.speaker: You
spy_shop.text: What do you have in stock?

spy_shop.speaker: Shopkeeper
spy_shop.text: Come by the shop. Describing some of it over the phone would invalidate the warranty.

tavern.speaker: Bartender
tavern.text: The tavern. We serve drinks, not alibis.

tavern.speaker: Bartender
tavern.text: Plenty. Come in and order something. Gossip travels badly through copper wire.

unknown_advertiser.speaker: You
unknown_advertiser.text: It was printed in an advertisement.

unknown_advertiser.speaker: Unknown Voice
unknown_advertiser.text: Then our security has been compromised.
